rationale: Adds the in-app update service (pulp::format::AppUpdateService), its EditorBridge messages and @pulp/react client, and the standard macOS application-menu layout (About, Check for Updates, Services, Hide, Quit) for standalone apps. The touched @pulp/react file is a new, self-contained bridge client exported from the package index; it does not change the reconciler, host config, prop appliers, materialized-import metadata or any render/asset/backend path. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves; Pulp-only.
